answer: No. As of February 1, 2026, the odometer disclosure statement is form NW-ODO-2, which replaced NW-ODO-1, so bring NW-ODO-2 to your appointment instead. If you lease the car, bring your dealer payoff quote. Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
